title: Unclear error message for when trying to connect to a bluetooth peripheral while adapter it's paired to is disabled
line: Connecting to a device whose Bluetooth adapter is turned off now says that the adapter is off instead of showing a generic error.
explanation: With two adapters, devices paired to a turned off adapter can still be connected from the applet and the KCM. BlueZ then fails the call, and the applet's notification showed the generic "Connection to the device failed" while the KCM showed BlueZ's raw "Input/output error". When a connection fails and the device's adapter is not powered, the applet notification and the KCM messages (device list, device page, media center sidebar) now say "The Bluetooth adapter “<name>” is turned off" instead.

commits.message:
applet, kcm: say when a connection fails because the adapter is off

With more than one adapter, connecting to a device paired to an adapter
that is turned off only showed a generic "Connection to the device
failed" or "Input/output error". Name the turned off adapter instead.

BUG: 506264

media.caption: Bluetooth applet: connecting the headset paired to the turned off "internal" adapter gives "Connection to the device failed"
Bluetooth applet: the notification now says the "internal" adapter is turned off
Bluetooth KCM device list: Connect shows "Input/output error"
Bluetooth KCM device list: the message now names the turned off adapter
Bluetooth KCM device page: Connect shows "Input/output error"
Bluetooth KCM device page: the message now names the turned off adapter

review.text: Checking adapter power state on connection failure in bluedevil's applet proxy model and KCM pages cleanly replaces the vague "Connection to the device failed" and raw "Input/output error" messages with a clear, localized message naming the disabled adapter. The dbusmock before/after screenshots verify the applet notification, KCM device list, and KCM device page well (minor non-blocking nit: optional chaining on device?.adapter in DeviceConnectionSidebar.qml would also guard against an adapter being unplugged mid-call).

reviews.text: Checking adapter power state on connection failure in bluedevil's applet proxy model and KCM pages cleanly replaces the vague "Connection to the device failed" and raw "Input/output error" messages with a clear, localized message naming the disabled adapter. The dbusmock before/after screenshots verify the applet notification, KCM device list, and KCM device page well (minor non-blocking nit: optional chaining on device?.adapter in DeviceConnectionSidebar.qml would also guard against an adapter being unplugged mid-call).

Does what the reporter asked: when a connect fails and the device's adapter is unpowered, the applet notification and the KCM messages (list, device page, media center sidebar) name the turned off adapter instead of BlueZ's generic text. It checks AdapterPoweredRole / device.adapter.powered only after a real failure, so successful connects and failures with the adapter on are unchanged. The new makeCall(device) parameter is null-guarded for the pairing dialog path. The screenshots and the dbusmock two-adapter setup, which mimics real BlueZ's failure, show both texts from the report replaced. The diff, commit message and line agree.
